notes.title: The We Were Here series is coming to Nintendo Switch!
notes.content:
Dear Explorers,


Some of you know these halls all too well. You’ve wandered the frozen corridors of Castle Rock, walkie-talkie in hand, voice cracking through the static. You’ve solved puzzles, shouted directions, cracked codes, and yes, maybe left your partner behind once or twice. It happens.

For years, the We Were Here series has tested friendships on PC, PlayStation, and Xbox. Now, it’s time for a new expedition.


We’re super excited to announce that We Were Here, We Were Here Too, and We Were Here Together are coming to Nintendo Switch!

[previewyoutube="TF6n0lMsYv0;full"][/previewyoutube]
Your favourite co-op adventure is going handheld (or docked, if you want to see your friend betray you on the big screen).

To play on Switch, you’ll need two things: a Nintendo Switch Online Membership and an external microphone. The trilogy will also be backwards compatible with the Switch 2, so whether you’re playing on shiny new hardware or your trusty old console, you can still team up together. As always, you and your friend will both need a separate copy of the game you want to play.

If you're new here, We Were Here games are all about two players, trapped apart in a forgotten place, trying to escape through communication alone. You won’t see each other, and can only talk to each other over your walkie-talkies. Every puzzle you solve depends on how well you work together.

If you’re a weathered Explorer, this is your chance to bring a new partner to Castle Rock. That friend who only games on Switch? Time to hand them a walkie-talkie and hope they’re better at reading runes than you were.



Whether you're playing curled up in a blanket fort or squeezed into a train seat, remember:

You’re never truly alone…


See you on the other end of the walkie-talkie,
Total Mayhem Games

notes.title: Our Great Studio Migration!
notes.content:
2024 was a year in which our mighty developers haven’t been sitting still—quite the opposite. After months of exploring all the crooks and crannies of the vast terrain of Rotterdam, we have secured a beautiful and spacious new base in the booming city center!

We are growing!

Over the past year, our numbers have swelled, welcoming a host of talented and inspiring individuals to the fold. This is great news, but it did come with a downside. Our once-spacious studio at Schiehavenkade began to feel... rather snug. Long queues for the microwaves during feeding hours, overheated meeting rooms, and desks encroaching dangerously close to the entrance—a sure sign it was time to seek new territory. notes.title: Happy frenniversary! 🎉
notes.content:
Dear Explorers,


Happy Frenniversary! 🎉
It’s been one whole year since we launched We Were Here Expeditions: The FriendShip, and what an incredible year it’s been! Let’s take a trip down memory lane and revisit the exciting moments from the reveal of this special game. 


Crafting a Secret
After the release of We Were Here Forever in 2022, our team started plotting the next chapter in the We Were Here series. With Forever being our longest and most intricate adventure, packed with puzzles, mysteries, and expansive locations, we knew we wanted to offer something a little different next. This time, we aimed for something short, sweet, and perfect for explorers who want a bite-sized co-op experience.

We Were Here Expeditions: The FriendShip was born: a game designed to be fun, challenging, and most of all, an absolute blast to play with your friends, whether they’re seasoned fans of the We Were Here series or joining us for the first time. 

 
The Big Reveal at WASD x IGN 🎮
Now, we couldn’t just launch The FriendShip like any ordinary game. No, we wanted to do something BIG, something that would surprise and delight our amazing community! So, we decided to go full stealth mode, keeping the entire game a secret until its grand reveal at WASD x IGN. And what’s better than a surprise? A free surprise! 🎁 We dropped the game for free for the first month, allowing millions of you to hop aboard and set sail on this new co-op adventure.  [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44619513/2b7241314815735337511a526af068ba87da39bd.jpg"]The response was overwhelming! Over 6 million explorers claimed The FriendShip, joining our ever-growing We Were Here family. 💖 


Celebrating Friendship 🫶
At Total Mayhem Games, friendship is the heart and soul of everything we create. It’s the thread that ties all our games together, and it’s the bond we share with you, our amazing explorers. We simply couldn’t have reached this point without your endless love and support.  [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44619513/e0b56b7e1c49f6f6b1cd9835a6031e31c31463c1.png"]And guess what? There’s more on the horizon! We've got some exciting stuff coming up. So stay tuned, and always remember: “There are good ships, and wood ships, ships that sail the sea. But the best ships are friendships, and may they always be!”

Here’s to many more adventures together!


All the best,
Total Mayhem Games

notes.content:
Dear Explorers! 

We hope everyone is doing well and had a great summer break! We've got new exciting things to share with you all.

 We Are Fighting Loneliness 

We are incredibly excited to announce that we are working together with  British Red Cross  for  Operation Anti-Loneliness 2022!
The core of our games is that you have to team up with someone else, work together and communicate with each other, and we have always encouraged forming bonds and social connections through gaming. So what better way to celebrate Operation Anti-Loneliness than by playing We Were Here Forever?! 1 in 5 people in the UK are affected by loneliness, and one of the things streamers can do to help is to fundraise money by streaming We Were Here Forever for 5, 10 or 20 hours.

notes.title: We are here Together, to share big news about We Were Here Forever!
notes.content:
Dear Explorers,

We’re more than excited to share some big news about our upcoming game We Were Here Forever! Check out our new reveal trailer here!

[previewyoutube=Ztz99oZXjOU;full][/previewyoutube]

Yes, on May 10 We Were Here Forever will be released on Steam! Bringing you more puzzles to solve, places to discover and mysteries to unravel. Console versions will follow shortly after!

Discover what has been forgotten
The 4th instalment in our We Were Here Series is our biggest game yet. You’ll be exploring more of Castle Rock- what’s hiding in the dark corridors, the dungeon below as well as forgotten halls and chambers, once filled with life and joy. A graveyard for those who’ve fallen, a chapel and even a puppet workshop are a few of the new areas awaiting your exploration…

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40040727/b1ded59667b617e284be58ad02e7795460574f9d.png

Castle Rock and the town of Rockbury await your arrival. Swallowed by a terrible curse, Rockbury now only remains as a shadow of its former self. The town's previous inhabitants are long forgotten by time, but their plans of a resistance against the King remain.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40040727/015c4facd2ed23adb05d7dd9d4a54556f89bb8fc.png

Will you be able to unveil the mysteries and solve the puzzles that challenge the two of you? Who knows, perhaps this was all meant to be. You might be a missing puzzle piece of a larger story set in motion in a time long forgotten…
The big question at the end remains; does one ever truly escape Castle Rock?

We are Here in live action
Besides a new trailer and release date, we have more in store for you! In our live action show We Were Here Stories: Chronicles of Castle Rock, the backstory of the cursed castle in the We Were Here Series will be told through the eyes of resident Kees Klokkenmaker. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40040727/e538d02998787c7c915b2d9540bc41d6465dac13.png

The Chronicles bring six chapters, each narrated by one of his descendants. You’ll learn about the fall of a great Dutch king, who went mad in his search for eternal life. How this monarch met his downfall, is for you to discover in the series and game.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40040727/69ccc8bf303ec82215404dcda73ff5b2ffdbfd20.png

The first episode “The Fall of a Kingdom” is already live! Be sure to watch it here!

[previewyoutube=p21_SLlw6jc;full][/previewyoutube]

We Were Here Podcast

Can’t get enough from all the lore we have for you? Need some refreshment so you’re completely up to date upon We Were Here Forever’s release? Don’t forget to check out our YouTube channel where we discuss the lore of the series and more! Click here for the latest one!

Thank you for everything explorers! 
We can’t wait to see you all play our game!

Yours Forever,
Total Mayhem Games

[olist]
 Find our post about “Become part of We Were Here Forever … Forever” on one of our social channels.
